name: llmjpvl_sglang
description: SGLang support for LLMjpVLModel (llm-jp-4-vl): a plugin, no sglang file changed. Model = sglang SiglipVisionModel -> pixel shuffle -> mlp1 -> LlamaForCausalLM with the HF weight names mapped; processor = the HF LLMjpVLProcessor tiling and <|image_pad|> expansion; serving_chat hook undoing the spaces the llm-jp tokenizer's decode inserts after special tokens (the re-encoded prompt equals the rendered one). Ported from llm-jp/llmjpvl sglang_plugin (BSD-3-Clause), tested there on sglang 0.5.13.post1 against the HF implementation.
